objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction subject to creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type-based abbreviation with consecutive number (e.g. RL_0001).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status (e.g. editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current version number of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document content.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Areas of validity or relevant companies for the document.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document attached to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status within the release lifecycle of the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary information object attached to a document that is not subject to the release cycle and can be published directly.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Whether the additional info has been published via property switches.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal to amend an existing released document, managed independently of the document version until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request to review and extend the validity of a document before it expires.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the request.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate (suspend) a document and trigger the archiving process.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the override request.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the reactivation request.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who can act as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, or reader within the system.

attributes.name: system_role
attributes.description: License role assigned (e.g. Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator, Reader).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A group of users used for authorization assignment and distribution (e.g. Reader group, Author group, Archive group).

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: Name of the user group.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: The list of user groups and persons assigned to a document for email notification or acknowledgement upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by email or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type used when creating new documents.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: A classification category for documents defining abbreviation, validity period, and archive duration.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Standard type abbreviation for the document type.

attributes.name: validity_period
attributes.description: Default period for validity extension checks (e.g. 3 years).

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Default duration for archiving before physical deletion (e.g. 10 years).

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system by attaching a new information object with a selected document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type_selected
attributes.description: The document type chosen during creation.

attributes.name: template_selected
attributes.description: The template chosen during creation, if any.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client in a local Office application.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: The saved document is automatically converted to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval process (Creator-Review-Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step (Creator step) with an electronic signature.

evts.name: complete_review
evts.description: A reviewer completes the review task (technical or formal check) with an electronic signature.

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Whether the review was technical or formal.

attributes.name: decision
attributes.description: Positive approval or rejection.

evts.name: reject_review
evts.description: A reviewer rejects the document during the review step, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided for the rejection.

evts.name: complete_release
evts.description: A releaser completes the release task with an electronic signature, finalizing the document release.

attributes.name: decision
attributes.description: Positive approval or rejection.

evts.name: reject_release
evts.description: A releaser rejects the document during the release step, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided for the rejection.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created for revision, retaining all previous data.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: Reason for new version (content change, attachment change, change proposal implementation, reactivation).

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: An attachment object is created and linked to a main document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is created and linked to a document without affecting the document version.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is deleted from a document without affecting the document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for an existing released document by a user with author rights.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of the change proposal, marking it as completed and notifying the creator.

evts.name: generate_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically creates a validity extension request 30 days before the document's valid-until date.

evts.name: confirm_validity_extension
evts.description: The releaser (or author/reviewer/releaser in process 2) confirms additional validity, updating the valid-until date.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document and start the override workflow.

evts.name: confirm_override
evts.description: The override is confirmed, setting the document status to out of force and revoking all rights except archive group.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A Business Admin group member creates a request to reactivate an invalidated document.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: The reactivation is confirmed, creating a new version of the document and restoring authorizations and attachments.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Upon release, users and user groups on the distribution list receive an email notification about the new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Upon release, users and user groups on the distribution list are requested to actively confirm acknowledgement.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a released document version via a workflow task.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to user groups or persons for a specific document.

attributes.name: authorization_type
attributes.description: Type of authorization assigned (read, write).

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language by a translator.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language the document is translated into.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated version is checked and released with workflow support, making it visible in the corresponding login language.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language of the released translation.

evts.name: physical_deletion
evts.description: After the archive duration expires, the archived document is physically deleted from the system.
